rows.ARS:
Orange blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Just Joey (Hybrid Tea, Cants, 1972)
rows.Origin:
Bred by P. Roger Pawsey (United Kingdom, 1972).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Cants of Colchester Ltd. in 1972 as 'Just Joey'.
Introduced in Australia by Ross Roses in 1979 as 'Just Joey'.
rows.Bloom: Buff - orange. Strong fragrance. 30 petals. Average diameter 5". Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, cluster-flowered, in small clusters, classic hybrid tea, ruffled bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy. Glossy, medium green, leathery foliage.

Height: 30" to 4' (75 to 120cm). Width: up to 4' (up to 120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b through 10b. Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) . Feed this rose well.
rows.Parentage:
Fragrant Cloud (hybrid tea, Tantau 1963) ×
Dr. A.J. Verhage
